content:
sara: Heads-up — I ran the audit coverage diff for customer-facing events. We still have holes across gateway/auth/console/billing/runtime. Pulling a quick triage so we can hand off backlog items.

jkumar: Thanks. Can you paste the top missing event types?

sara: Top gaps: 1) gateway: missing token.refresh and token.revoke events (no user_id). 2) auth: failed-password-attempt lacks ip/session metadata. 3) console: role-assignment uses legacy schema (actor_id instead of user.id). 4) billing: invoice-download not logged. 5) runtime: model-fallback & throttled-response missing request_id.

lia: For gateway events we already emit wire logs, but they don't go to audit pipeline. We need a lightweight forwarder to proto schema. This is a 1-2 day infra task.

ivan: Runtime side — model-fallback is tricky because it's emitted from several workers. We need a consistent helper lib to attach request_id + route. I can own the helper if someone creates the issue.

maya: From product/customer side, we need evidence format for SOC/audit requests. They expect user_id, action, outcome, resource, timestamp, request_id. Can we standardize and validate before shipping to customers?

helen: KMS/RBAC note: when we add user_id to token events we must avoid leaking KMS key ids or plaintext key material. Also check that role-assignment events don't include secret ARNs.

audit-bot: automated scan: schema mismatches detected in 12 events across services. Missing required fields: request_id, user.id, outcome. See /infra/audit-schema/v1/diff-1765432109 for details. :eyes:

sara: Suggested triage: short infra tasks (gateway forwarder, schema validation hook), small SDK change (runtime helper), console schema migration, billing event hook, and a docs/evidence checklist for customers.

jkumar: Prioritization: gateway/auth/console -> P0 (customer-facing evidence), runtime/billing -> P1. Also add an automated validation gate on the audit ingestion pipeline so future regressions fail CI.

sam: I can schedule a 30m sync tomorrow for owners and assign sprint tickets. Preferred owners: gateway -> lia, auth/console schema -> jkumar + maya, runtime helper -> ivan, billing hook -> product-engineering (maya to route).

lia: Quick example of the validation we want to enforce in CI: 
```
required = ["timestamp", "request_id", "user.id", "action", "outcome", "service"]
for k in required:
  assert k in event
```

ivan: I'll start the runtime helper PR. Assign to me: #SEC-3267.

helen: I'll review role-assignment event fields and create sample redaction rules so we don't send key identifiers.

maya: I'll draft the customer evidence checklist and mapping to SOC fields. I'll post a draft doc by EOD Friday.

jkumar: Action items summary: 1) Create infra ticket for gateway forwarder (lia). 2) Add ingestion validation gate + schema diff run in CI (jkumar). 3) Console schema migration plan + quick patch for actor_id -> user.id (jkumar + maya). 4) Runtime helper PR (ivan). 5) Billing event hook + sampling (maya). 6) KMS sensitive-field redaction rules (helen). 7) 30m sync for owners (sam).

sara: Great — please add the tickets and tag @eng-security. I'll update the audit backlog with the new priorities. :thumbsup:

sam: :shipit: I'll calendar the sync for 10:00am UTC tomorrow.

audit-bot: note: added labels [audit-coverage, p0, triage] to newly created placeholder issue SEC-3267-placeholder.

jkumar: One more: can we add a small end-to-end test that simulates a user flow (login -> console role change -> billing download) and asserts audit events are present? That will catch cross-service gaps.

sara: Yes — let's include that in the validation gate plan.

lia: I'll estimate infra work and post a timeboxed plan in the issue.

ivan: Ping me once the issue exists, I'll link the helper PR.

helen: I'll coordinate with compliance on the evidence format so the checklist matches what they accept.

maya: Thanks all. Very helpful.

sara: Closing notes: expect tickets by EOD, owners assigned in thread, follow-up after sync. :warning: keep customer-facing evidence top priority.
